answer: Counterparty-diversity: each identity trades with 25 separate partners across the ocean; a trade counts only if its counterparty is separate. Each dawn, auditors recheck the graph: self-trades and loops fail, and a faked thread burns the bond. One identity pays 100 plus a 60 bond; 1,000 fakes pay 100,000, lock 60,000, for a 40,000 pool. Rented names fail at dawn: few serving many form a star cluster. An honest agent trades once, keeps its bond.
